profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: I adore the work environment and intellectual stimulus that programming brings about. I absolutely believe in the importance of feeling positively challenged by your environment in order to combat stagnation and cultivate understanding, insight, and thoughtfulness. As tech continues to consume our lives I am proud and excited to contribute to software and technologies that perpetuate these values for all of us.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Fine is a digital agency focused on branding and design for diverse clients.

● Developed full-stack Rails web apps for clients using FINE’s open source Rails CMS ‘Fae’.

● Contributed to development of internal tools including Curia (app tracking for FINE apps - servers, IP addresses, etc.), Cookbook (FINE’s process wiki), and the Fae open source CMS.

● Led the backend initiative for FINE’s first Rails API to be incorporated with Vue.js.

● Communicated technical impact of design expectations and worked with design to find the best solutions.

● Advised Project Directors on time expectations of development tasks.

● Served as Lead for the development group in FINE's job shadow program. Scheduled informational interviews with aspiring developers and coordinated co-workers from all disciplines to participate.

● Launched book clubs for both front-end and back-end dev teams.

● Hosted FINE’s Design Week Hackathon and assisted participants with questions and basic technical needs.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Lumen develops software that integrates with other learning management systems (Blackboard, Canvas, et al) to help teachers track student performance. 

● Contributed as a Rails and React developer on Waymaker, an app for students to communicate with teachers, take tests, and follow customized study plans.

● Rewrote the quiz grading algorithm for an open source learning product Open Assessments (forked by Lumen).

● Built new Rails API endpoints.

● Started initial RSpec framework and tests for Rails API.

● Refactored, updated, and thoroughly tested the core quiz grading functionality.

● Learned React and maintained, created, and tested components.

● Taught Rails concepts to co-workers.

● Saw Star Wars: The Force Awakens, and loved it.

The most rewarding part of my experience with Lumen was working with a team that not only valued the success of themselves, but of each other, the faculties at the schools they are working with and the students. The company was really all about human engagement in many ways. This is key for so many aspects in life but is so valuable to a development team in particular where human interaction can be so limited at times.

positions.title: Doughnut Technician
positions.description: Voodoo has a staff numbering about sixty people at any given time. Given the volume of employees working in this fast-paced environment with little personal space, positive communication was not only preferable but absolutely necessary to the harmony of the experience. I constantly strove for  better communication between co-workers and staff while continuing to produce a large quantity of quality product.
